This document out lines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
 out every three months as indicated by M3 
 in the title block.

The induced draft fan function: pulling the 
 combustion gases from the furnace through the heat
 transfer surface in the superheaters, reheaters, economizer, gases side preheater into the stock.

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Emad El din Ali, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by 
EDEPC 
inspection & quality control 
 eng. Samir Abd El- Gelil, 
approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif; head

 قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة.

Work to be Carried 
Out
Before Isolating the Induced Draft Fan Mechanically and Electrically

قياس الاهتزاز، 
 قيمة الإعداد هي 3:6 مل

Listen and check any 
 abnormal noise.

Check the lubrication oil 
 level in front and rear bearing housing.

Check the temperature of 
 rear and front bearing, 
 the setting value is 800 oF

Check any leakage of oil 
 lubrication from front or rear bearing.

Check any leakage of water 
 cooling from front or rear bearing.

Read and check the quantity 
 of air according lead.

Check any oil leakage from 
 dust seal.

sections.text: After Isolating the Induced Draft Fan Mechanically and Electrically
Check the front / rear bearing and replace the defect bearing.
Check the shaft seals and replace it if needed.
Dismantle the safety cover of the coupling and check the following:
Check any leakage from O rings or gasket

Check gap with feeler for hob separation at 90oC 
 points = 1/8"
تحقق من محاذاة المحاور مع الحواف المستقيمة 90oC points
Lubricant hub and sleeve teeth with new grease before cleaning all parts
Check the alignment of the coupling half's and realign it if needed.
Clean the pipes of water cooling by opening the drains.
Check and clean the check valve of water cooling.
Check and retighten all bolts.
Check every part well.

After successful inspection, operate the 
 fan again, read all available record values and put them in table (2) and compare 
 between the values before and after inspection
